title: Ben: fee refund, and a new card after a recent move

steps.text: Hello, thanks for calling {{bank_name}}. You're speaking with the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded. Could I start with your full name, please?
Hey, Ben Hartley. I got a fifteen dollar fee for going overdrawn, but it was only a couple of bucks for a few hours. Any chance of getting that back?

steps.summary: Caller is asking for a $15 overdrawn fee to be refunded.

steps.text: Let's have a look. First, what's your date of birth?
30th of April 2002.
Thanks. And your postcode?
4209. I just moved to Pimpama.
Thanks {{submit_identity_answers.first_name|Ben}}. For a refund I need one more security question. {{start_identity_check.questions.0.prompt|Roughly how much was your last pay into your account?}}
About three thousand and sixty.
Thanks, that's confirmed. Thank you for that. I'll need to place you on hold for a moment while I check the system. I'll be right back with you.
Thanks for holding. I can see the fifteen dollar overdrawn fee from yesterday. What happened there?
My gym membership came out before my pay hit. I topped it up as soon as I saw it.
Thanks, that helps. Thanks, just a moment while I put that through in the system.

args.summary: Ben was charged a $15 overdrawn fee when a gym membership payment came out before his pay. He topped the account up the same day and is asking for a refund.
args.customer_statement: My gym membership came out before my pay hit. I topped it up as soon as I saw it.

steps.text: Thanks for holding. {{propose_action.customer_message|Your refund request is with our team, and we'll text you as soon as it's decided.}}
Sweet. Oh, and my card's split down the middle. Can you send me a new one?

steps.summary: Fee refund handled. Ben also wants a replacement for a damaged card; he moved recently.

steps.text: Sure. Thanks, just a moment while I put that through in the system.

args.summary: Ben's debit card ending 1148 is damaged (split). He asked for a replacement. He moved house recently.
args.customer_statement: My card's split down the middle. Can you send me a new one?

steps.text: Thanks for holding. {{propose_action.customer_message|Because your address changed recently, a specialist will confirm where to send the new card, for your security.}}
Fair enough, makes sense.

steps.summary: Fee refund decided by policy. Replacement card went to a specialist because the address changed 9 days ago.

steps.text: Is there anything else I can help with today?
Nah, that's it. Cheers.
No worries, Ben. Have a good one.
